newsitem.title: USA: Wendy's to acquire 37 Rax Restaurants.
newsitem.headline: Wendy's to acquire 37 Rax Restaurants.

text.p: Wendy's International said on Friday it has signed a letter of intent to acquire 37 Rax restaurants for an undisclosed sum of cash.
The transaction was expected to be completed by the end of January, the restaurant company said.

At least 30 of the restaurants, mostly located in central Ohio and West Virginia, would be converted to Tim Hortons fresh baked goods restaurants, it said. The remaining seven would become Wendy's restaurants.

Gordon Teter, president, chief executive officer and chief operating officer, said. "With five Tim Hortons already in development in central Ohio, this acquisition will enable the rapid expansion of Canada's largest coffee and fresh baked goods chain."
